import.output: versioned import/loss envelope; canonical text is present only when every Hostwright v3 requirement is representable
import.controlAPI: none in the library call; import-stack is available through a persistent unary read-only CLI route

export.controlAPI: none in the library call; export-stack is available through a persistent unary read-only CLI route

updatePlan.input: current and desired validated Hostwright manifest models
updatePlan.output: sorted service changes and loss report
updatePlan.controlAPI: none in the library call; plan-stack-update is available through a persistent unary read-only CLI route

cliAndControl.authorization: export derives one manifest-backed project UUID; update planning parses both retained inputs and requires the same non-empty project before execution

exportUpdateInputSnapshot.reads: one per distinct standardized resolved path identity before authorization and execution; repeated strings and dot-segment aliases share one snapshot
exportUpdateInputSnapshot.execution: authorization and execution use only the retained snapshots
exportUpdateInputSnapshot.reportedPaths: the bounded normalized user arguments, never an inferred canonical host path

cliAndControl.failure: validation exit; standard output is empty; JSON is emitted on standard error; failed export has null composeText and rejected update has empty changes

resources.cpus: normalized positive whole decimal CPU count; fractional, exponent, signed, zero, padded, and overflowing values rejected
resources.memory: normalized positive integer plus case-insensitive b|k|kb|m|mb|g|gb; binary mapping to B|KiB|MiB|GiB; other, zero, and overflowing values rejected
resources.canonicalExport: quoted CPU and memory scalars; memory uses b|k|m|g

canonicalComposeSubset.ordering: service and map keys sorted; ports and volumes sorted; command and healthcheck sequences preserve order

lossReport.proceed: false when any loss has severity error

codes.HW-COMPOSE-003: Hostwright semantics not representable by canonical Compose subset
codes.HW-COMPOSE-005: update plan rejected before changes are produced

boundaries.unsupportedSemantics: reject with deterministic loss paths; never silently drop
boundaries.resourceAdmission: Hostwright manifest v3 requires all four explicitly authored deploy.resources reservations/limits CPU and memory fields. Missing or partial capacity, all other deploy/resource/device fields, malformed or ambiguous values, YAML anchors/aliases/merges, inline mappings, and duplicate declarations fail closed; capacity is never inferred.
boundaries.resourceExport: The exact CPU/memory subset exports symmetrically only when all four fields are present. Partial resource models and Hostwright disk, I/O, network, process, scheduling/accelerator, TiB, or out-of-range memory semantics return HW-COMPOSE-003 before export or update changes are produced.
boundaries.execution: not implemented by this source-only contract slice
